description: Bank volume, loose volume after swell and truck loads for a trench or pit, with vertical or sloped walls. Every parameter is optional and has a default. Preliminary planning only. Swell factors are planning values; use your geotechnical figure where you have one. The engineer of record and conditions on site govern.

length.description: Bottom length. Unit: m or ft.

material.description: Material, used to set the swell factor when swell is not given.

sides.description: Where the slope applies: long sides only (trench with vertical ends) or all four sides (pit).

slope.description: Horizontal run per 1 vertical on the walls: 0 for vertical, 1 (Type 1 to 3 soil, 1 vertical to 1 horizontal), 3 (Type 4 soil, 1 vertical to 3 horizontal), or any other number.

swell.description: Swell factor. Default is the middle of the published range for the material (earth 25). Unit: percent.

truck.description: Truck body capacity, loose. Unit: m3.

width.description: Bottom width. Unit: m or ft.

name: excavation_spoil_volume_calculator
title: Excavation and Spoil Volume Calculator
